headline: Trevor Noah is hosting Google’s Pixel 11 launch event
summary: Google will host its Made by Google hardware event on August 12th. Comedian Trevor Noah is confirmed to host the Pixel 11 launch. The event is expected to feature other celebrities and influencers.

headline: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
summary: Jony Ive and OpenAI are developing an AI device resembling a hockey puck-sized smart speaker. It will be battery-powered and lack a display. The device is rumored to launch in 2027 with a price over $300.

headline: The AirPods Pro are $60 off, their best price since late June
summary: Apple AirPods Pro are currently available for $189.99, a $60 discount. This price marks their lowest point since late June. The deal is matched by major retailers including Best Buy, Amazon, and Walmart.

headline: The Zelda movie’s Ganondorf casting hints at more movies
summary: Uli Latukefu has been cast as Ganondorf in The Legend of Zelda movie. The actor reportedly signed a multi-picture deal for the role. This suggests Nintendo and Sony may be planning multiple Zelda films.

headline: Will Wight's Cradle Series Is a Must-Read for Anime Fans Who Just Discovered Their Love of LitRPG
summary: Will Wight's 'Cradle Series' is highly recommended for fans of LitRPG. The books are especially appealing to those new to the genre, particularly anime enthusiasts. This series offers an engaging experience for its target audience.

headline: Layoffs Hit Staff at Crossfire Developer That’s No Moon
summary: That's No Moon, the developer behind Crossfire, has announced layoffs. An unspecified number of staff have been impacted by the job cuts. This marks another instance of workforce reduction within the gaming industry.

headline: The First Fourth Wing Graphic Novel Is Up for Preorder on Amazon, Out April 2027
summary: The first graphic novel adaptation of 'Fourth Wing' is now available for preorder. It can be preordered through Amazon. The anticipated release date for the graphic novel is April 2027.

headline: American Squid Game Spinoff Series Reportedly Canceled at Netflix
summary: Netflix has reportedly shelved its planned American 'Squid Game' spinoff series. The project was previously associated with director David Fincher. Sources close to the production indicate the cancellation.

headline: Officer who led PC Harper investigation 'appalled' killers could be released early
summary: Former Det Sup Stuart Blaik, lead investigator for PC Harper's death, spoke publicly for the first time. He expressed his strong disapproval over the potential early release of the killers. Blaik conveyed his 'appalled' reaction to the early release possibility.

headline: Arrests in Norfolk town as disorder continues for third night
summary: Arrests have been made in a Norfolk market town following ongoing disorder. The unrest is linked to anti-immigration protests. This marks the third consecutive night of disturbances in the area.

headline: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
summary: Meta received a $567 million fine in a significant child safety ruling. This penalty adds to $375 million already ordered, totaling $942 million. It represents the largest child safety fine ever imposed on a social media company.

headline: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
summary: Donald Trump disputes claims of a US weapons shortage. He stated that those leaking such information are being 'hunted down.' Publicly available data suggests many difficult-to-manufacture weapons have been depleted by the US.
